markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early when the 53-man roster is announced.
markets.rules_primary: If J.J. McCarthy is listed on the Minnesota initial 53-man active roster during the 2026 Pro Football season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, J.J. McCarthy makes the 53-man roster if the player is listed on Minnesota's initial 53-man active roster for the 2026 Pro Football season following the final preseason roster reduction. Practice-squad and reserve-list designations, including injured reserve, physically unable to perform, non-football injury/illness, suspended, and exempt lists, do not count as inclusion on the 53-man active roster. If the player is listed on the initial 53-man active roster and is later waived, released, traded, or moved to a reserve list, the market still resolves Yes. Resolution is based on official roster and transaction records published.
